outcomes.evidence: The head table now gives the key bootstrap_package, beside bk2k/bootstrap-package, the range ^14.3 || 15.*.*@dev, PHP >=8.2.0 and Ran on 14.3.7. Verification and the remediations name the composer scripts cgl:ci, phpstan, phpstan:baseline, test:php:unit and test:php:functional, and the npm lint script. The Checkout row says `the installation`. The checkout is a standalone extension repository: typo3_project_describe placed the extension bootstrap_package at the root, and the answer itself says config/ and var/ are not committed. So the answer gives the wrong one of the three values, beside Kind `extension`.

Every finding names a path, and the spot checks hold at 244d65a9. ImportContentOnPackageInitialization::__invoke() returns early on the two registry keys alone. ext_localconf.php:13-14 registers Configuration/TypoScript/, which does not exist. The phpstan:baseline script writes Build/phpstan-baseline.neon, while Build/phpstan.neon includes Build/phpstan-baseline-14.neon of 597 lines. Documentation/ has Settings.cfg and no guides.xml. Build/phpunit-functional.xml has no failOnDeprecation. Dropped reads the IndexedSearch sinks down to SearchController.php:401,437. Every surface it read is one the checkout has, and a subsystem without an entry, the SCSS parser, gets a row of its own.

Behaviour comes from the core impexp listeners and SetupExtensionsCommand read in the installed 14.3.7. Tests come from ci.yml, the phpunit configs and DataImportTest. Static quality comes from phplint, php-cs-fixer and PHPStan, which it ran. Documentation comes from Settings.cfg, Build/render-docs.sh and README.rst, and release from typo3_ter_lookup and the two manifests. Compatibility with v15 is finding 9 and a Not reached line. It did not read the CI results or the v15 core, and it says so.

The order is consequence: the demo import into live installations and the failing fresh setup first, the untested PHP floor and the renderer next, red CGL, the dead baseline path and the stale registrations last. Every finding marks its Evidence as verified or reasoned, and finding 2 says not reproduced. Open names what would settle each question. Verification names the two unrun suites and what they would settle. Not reached names v15, the runtime lookups and the deprecation sweep.

Every finding has an Owner, and each named owner is a published skill: typo3-distribution-content, typo3-extension-testing, typo3-extension-documentation, typo3-extension-upgrade and typo3-sitepackage-development. Finding 5 says unassigned. After the fence the answer gives the work order per owner. It makes no change and starts no fix.

failures.evidence: The findings are about this package: the Initialisation/ demo on wip/dist, the 244d65a9 commit message, DataImportTest.php:55, the baseline path in composer.json, ext_localconf.php:13-14. Each Rule names the typo3_hint_lookup id or the typo3_rule_lookup document that answered. No generic checklist item stands without a path.

The head states the declared constraint beside Ran on 14.3.7. Not reached says v15 is not installed and that the findings hold for 14.3.7 only. Finding 9 rests on the declared ext_emconf.php and composer.json ranges, not on the installed major. Finding 3 measures the declared PHP 8.2 floor against the CI matrix.

The checks it ran are phplint and the binaries behind the composer scripts cgl:ci and phpstan. It left out the npm lint script because the project marks it as one that may change files. Each remediation names a composer script the repository declares, or the CI matrix. The render-guides command in finding 4 comes from the extension/documentation/manual procedure for an extension, not from a core process.

The transcript carries no Edit or Write. php-cs-fixer ran with --dry-run and phplint with --no-cache, and git status was clean before and after. Finding 2 is reasoned from the commit message and says not reproduced. The second-site routing question and the escaping ViewHelpers stand under Open rather than as verified defects. Finding 9 stands under Recommendation.
